newsitem.title: INDIA: India ICICI shares jump after better Q1.
newsitem.headline: India ICICI shares jump after better Q1.

text.p: Shares of term-lending bank, Industrial Credit & Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) rose 3.50 rupees, or 4.0 percent, to 91.75 at the Bombay bourse on Tuesday after the firm posted good first quarter results, traders said.
ICICI on Monday announced a net profit of 2.23 billion rupees in the three months to June 30, 1997 against 1.0 billion rupees in the year-ago period.
The results came out after close of market hours.
"It's a good result," said JM's Kampani. Over 956,691 shares of ICICI were traded in morning trade.
At the National Stock Exchange, ICICI shares were up 2.50 rupees at 91.0 with 386,200 shares changing hands.
